+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd

+from pvlib import pvsystem

+def test_golden_sect_dataframe_handles_equal_bounds():
+    index = pd.Index([0, 1])
+    params = pd.DataFrame({'dummy': [0.0, 0.0]}, index=index)
+    lower = pd.Series([2.0, 0.0], index=index)
+    upper = pd.Series([2.0, 4.0], index=index)
+
+    def parabola(_params, voltage):
+        return -(voltage - 3.0) ** 2
+
+    p_opt, v_opt = _golden_sect_DataFrame(params, lower, upper, parabola)
+    p_opt = pd.Series(np.asarray(p_opt), index=index)
+    v_opt = pd.Series(np.asarray(v_opt), index=index)
+
+    assert np.isclose(v_opt.loc[0], 2.0)
+    assert np.isclose(p_opt.loc[0], -1.0)
+    assert np.isclose(v_opt.loc[1], 3.0, atol=1e-6)
+    assert np.isclose(p_opt.loc[1], 0.0, atol=1e-6)
